quote.text: I just bought a house and have no idea what needs doing

promise.text: New house checklist: the first week after closing

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "house"

lines.text: Secure access, check alarms and utilities, and turn the inspection report into a short first-week record without tackling every repair.

items.text: Arrange exterior rekeying or replacement as appropriate, and change garage, alarm and smart-access permissions.
Locate the water shutoff, electrical panel and utility emergency contacts without removing equipment covers.
Keep an accessible escape route and identify urgent inspection findings before using unfamiliar systems.

eyebrow.text: Capture facts without making a full inventory

items.text: Photograph accessible rating plates for heating, cooling, hot water and major appliances.
Mark installation dates confirmed, estimated or unknown; distinguish recollection from paperwork.
Collect manuals, warranties, service receipts and transfer instructions.
Verify compatible filter specifications before buying supplies.
Protect closing papers and the inspection report, with a separate backup.
Ask focused seller questions, but use manufacturer or professional advice for technical decisions.
